messages:
Alex: heads-up — I'm putting together a compact 'term bank' playbook for docs PRs: mapping terms, recommended voice patterns, and a migration checklist. Looking for owners + a lightweight label scheme for GH.
Maya: love that. can we include a short set of examples for SDK snippets (JS + Python) so reviewers have concrete guidance?
Sam: yes please — small runnable snippets, not big paragraphs. also want a rule for param case (snake_case vs camelCase) in examples.
Lina: proposal: docs examples use the SDK idiomatic style (JS => camelCase, Py => snake_case). add a short rationale blurb.
Sree: +1. for naming: prefer 'model variant' when talking about quantized/tuned builds, and 'model' for topology. avoids confusion.
Alex: noted — I'll add those two definitions to the playbook. also thinking of a PR label: docs/terminology, docs/snippet, docs/migration. keeps review triage easy.
Maya: can CI auto-apply labels? makes life easier.
CI Bot: Suggestion: add a GitHub Actions job to tag PRs when they touch /docs or glossary files. sample config:```yaml
name: label-docs
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  label:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Apply label
        uses: actions/labeler@v2
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
Alex: nice — add that to the repo and we'll have Docs Bot leave a comment when labels are applied.
Docs Bot: I will post a link to the playbook whenever a PR gets docs/terminology.
Sam: for migration checklist let's include: 1) glossary entry, 2) snippet migration (if applicable), 3) redirect or link-fix, 4) changelog note.
Lina: plus: add a small evaluation step — run a quick smoke example to ensure migrated snippet compiles. one-liner commands encouraged.
Maya: naming edge-case: Product docs sometimes use 'Dedicated' vs 'Dedicated capacity' — playbook should prefer the full form on first mention, short form after.
Sree: also include a canonical file for glossary entries (e.g., /docs/glossary/terms.md) so ownership is clear.
Alex: final asks: volunteers to review initial draft? I'm doing first pass tonight. @Maya @Sam can you do a quick sweep tomorrow? @Lina you ok owning the snippet examples section?
Maya: I can review.
Sam: i'll take label automation and the migration checklist.
Lina: happy to own snippets.
Alex: great — i'll drop a PR with the playbook + GH Action sample. tagging this thread on the PR. thanks all :sparkles:
CI Bot: PR #4321 created by Alex has label docs/terminology applied.
Docs Bot: Playbook PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — adding reviewers: Maya, Sam, Lina
Maya: quick note — when you add examples, keep token-cost examples small and include expected output for clarity.
Alex: will do. short runnable examples + expected outputs.
Sam: also suggest a tiny lint rule in docs CI to flag ambiguous terms (regex list) — low false positive threshold.
Lina: ok — we can start with a list of 8-10 high-friction terms and expand later.
Sree: copying product comms to ensure consistency.
Alex: perfect. closing loop: I'll publish the playbook draft and ping in #docs once PR is merged. if anything urgent, reply here.
